Hi Oleg,

Some companies go quiet before an IPO. OpenAI is doing the opposite.

Ahead of what could be “one of the largest [IPOs] in history,”¹ OpenAI is reportedly in talks with investors to raise fresh capital at a potential $1.2 trillion valuation.²

At the same time, the company is moving into new markets at full speed.

First, OpenAI acquired Glass Imaging, a startup founded by former Apple engineers. It’s a boost for the AI device OpenAI is reportedly developing with legendary Apple designer Jony Ive.³

Then, OpenAI named legal-tech firm Telon a “select partner,” embedding its models directly inside law firms and squaring off against legal-AI leader Harvey.⁴

A confidential filing does not guarantee that an IPO will occur. There’s also no guarantee that OpenAI’s valuation or revenue will continue to grow, or that the company will be profitable. See the risk disclosures on the offering page.

Add it up, and the strategy comes into focus. OpenAI wants to own the full AI stack: the models, the hardware they run on, and the software enterprises use every day.

The Innovators Fund (https://dxszHp04.na2.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/DR+113/dxszHp04/VWC7J-94gVlTW6vrhNj3lb0dbW6B8lDm5V755bN8DGmD-3pyd0W8wLKSR6lZ3krW3kSLRC3YB_3jW1Kzf7C8ZTVcvW3xfts-5FZNp9W5GfJfz2rq-5XW7fhgJw3-QP5JN7-Rcnl3FFM5W70vfzF2ztCFbVymqrc36RQd9W36Rh8G4xct7qW522N4K9kCRZnW77QMvy6LKkPKW2ZT2RG70P2dDW3rQ3xZ2cgcXkW1DJng34r2z_qW7C1sYS65m3XnW51RLbK80NCb_Vmr5bd73h1GXW1MLCm18VBsDBN3wvyrCWB-J5W8rwthB3-g__hW77H9rT2lPx4NVnYczn63lM0VW6B0zXG1FnrpxV36Lmj67KpVcW8_YwDn27smWTW7vLcQ37_4FMNVz78ff8_RzhcW3GFb2F45TYV2f4797zM04 ) is how you can gain exposure, but only until it closes next week.

With one check, accredited investors can gain exposure to OpenAI, along with “AI factory” Crusoe, quantum leader PsiQuantum, and Palmer Luckey’s new fintech Erebor.

You have less than a week left to secure your spot.
